pricing.headline: Pay once. Own the code.
pricing.body: Our engine is already built and reusable. We shape it to your requirements, so the price stays low and you never pay for extras you don't need.
points: One-time payment, no monthly software fee
Price set by the number of connections
The full codebase, yours to keep
pricing.note: A connection is one platform or account: a web store, a marketplace account, your warehouse system.

items.q: Do we have to change the systems we use?
items.a: No. We connect to what you already use through its API. If a system has no API, we work from its exports.
The engine is already built and reusable. We shape it to your requirements, so you pay for your setup, not for the basics or for extras you don't need.
No monthly software fee. You pay once, get the full codebase, and there is no limit on orders or products. You can run it on your own server, or we set it up for you.

items.q: How long does a build take?
items.a: It depends on the connections. You get the time together with the fixed price, after the call.

items.q: What if one of our platforms is down?
items.a: It retries and picks up where it stopped. Nothing is applied twice, every action is logged, and you get an alert if a run keeps failing.
